name: Stablecoin net-inflow as a crypto-native liquidity impulse — long when fresh dollars mint into the ecosystem
rationale: MECHANISM: a crypto-NATIVE liquidity read distinct from the TradFi WALCL/Fed leg — stablecoin_net_flow_usd captures fresh USD minting into the ecosystem (Tether/USDC issuance), which is the on-chain dry powder that gets deployed into risk BEFORE it shows in exchange price. Rising net inflow means new marginal buyers are funding up; this is the fastest, most PIT-honest liquidity signal available (on-chain, near-real-time — no FRED T+8 lag). The counterparty is slower on/off-ramp flow. Trade: long crypto beta when stablecoin_net_flow_usd is strongly positive AND price confirms with a range reclaim. DISCONFIRMER: mint flow can be inventory/treasury shuffling, not net new buying, and it can COINCIDE with rather than lead price (endogenous). Kill if the net-inflow entry fires only concurrent with the move (no lead) or if a plain range-reclaim momentum baseline captures the same OOS Sharpe without the stablecoin gate — the flow must add lift, not decorate momentum.
catalyst: strong stablecoin net inflow funding fresh crypto demand
